openings.claim: Exact envelope quantities and after-transfer marks may reduce omissions; quantity guidance and transfer attention remain distinct explanations.
openings.discriminator: Compare picking versus filling discrepancies; identical cues with before/after marking isolate transfer attention. Local materials test shared-tray interference.
openings.probe: Alternate matched small blocks: incumbent, shared trays with quantity checks, and local materials without checks; compare marking order with names and quantities fixed. Two volunteers audit contents, timing and crossings.
openings.uncertainty: Small-batch transfer, specification availability, writing/audit costs and causal stage remain unverified.

openings.claim: Local pre-counted batches with sample checks may reduce interference; replenishment, preparation and checking may erase the apparent advantage.
openings.discriminator: Matched mixtures distinguish easier-pattern effects; total audited time across replenishment distinguishes durable gains from uninterrupted-stock advantage.
openings.probe: Measure staged/open-packet area; compare matched shared/local blocks. In a full attempt log preparation, picking, filling, replenishment, corrections and crossings; stop at 90 minutes and report unfinished kits.
openings.uncertainty: O4 mixture, reserve sufficiency, occupied area and completion time are unknown; fewer crossings alone do not establish success.

openings.claim: Correct exterior pattern names may prevent exchanges caused by hidden identity; completeness still requires verification.
openings.discriminator: Compare assignment, legible name and contents when recording exchanges.
openings.probe: Pencil names, verify against contents before closure, include marking time, and tally distribution exchanges.
openings.uncertainty: Assignment access, consultation and timing remain unverified; mismatches may persist.

lineage.reason: Retains guidance, marking and interference comparison.
Retains local batching and stage-specific checks.

decision: Probe candidates only: evidence is entirely synthetic. Preserve specified quantities/dimensions; exactly two volunteers, at most 90 minutes, existing 180-by-75-centimetre table, envelopes and supplies; no purchases/equipment. Small probes prove no full-run outcome. Success requires all 60 kits ready within 90 minutes and at most one distribution correction.
